# neoshowcase_repository (Resource)

Registers and manages a Git repository in NeoShowcase. If the provider user already owns a repository with the same URL, the existing repository is adopted and reconciled with the configured name, authentication, and owners.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "neoshowcase_repository" "example" {
  name = "example"
  url  = "https://github.com/traPtitech/NeoShowcase.git"

  auth = {
    method = "none"
  }

  additional_owner_ids = []
}

output "repository_id" {
  value = neoshowcase_repository.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth` (Attributes) Repository authentication. SSH uses the system-wide NeoShowcase deploy key in this provider version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `name` (String) Repository display name.
- `url` (String) Git clone URL.

### Optional

- `additional_owner_ids` (Set of String) Exact set of owners managed in addition to the provider user.

### Read-Only

- `authoritative_owner_id` (String) ID of the provider user, which must always remain an owner.
- `effective_owner_ids` (Set of String) Actual owner set, including the authoritative provider user.
- `html_url` (String) Human-readable repository URL reported by NeoShowcase.
- `id` (String) NeoShowcase repository ID.

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Required:

- `method` (String) Authentication method: `none`, `basic`, or `ssh`.

Optional:

- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only BASIC authentication password. This value is never stored in Terraform state.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Increment this value to rotate `password_wo`.
- `username` (String) Username used by BASIC authentication.
